tasks.title: Isolate the one unexplained frame behind 5 Title Tunes' wave 90%
tasks.verify: THE ONE PIECE THE CENSUS DID NOT CLOSE, and it said so rather than papering over it. Measured already, take as given: 935 waveform-class ($D404 & $F0) mismatches, ALL 935 during an original release/rest frame and 0 during a sounding note -- exactly one mismatched frame per release run. The same 935 release runs carry the gate and adsr deficits, so this is ONE population and three registers, not three defects. What is NOT known is which side's boundary write lands where inside the 4-frame gap. Done when the per-frame picture of BOTH sides across a release run is written out -- for each of the 4 frames, what the original writes to $D404 and what we write -- and the single mismatching frame is named with its cause. Read-only: probe output to scratch, never build/fidelity.json. The probe MUST go through fidelity's own resolution (resolve_subtune / convert / legalise_restarts / pack_sid / run_siddump / startup_lag, in _measure()'s order) and MUST assert it reproduces the shipped row's wave 90% before drawing any conclusion from the finer breakdown -- the previous census did exactly that and it is why its numbers are trustworthy. A REFUTATION IS A VALID done: if the frame turns out to be unreachable (a hard-restart length the emitter cannot vary, say), say so and name what would have to change.

tasks.title: 5 Title Tunes' gate 50% is HARD_RESTART_FRAMES=2 against a uniformly 4-frame gap
tasks.needs_main_reason: corpus byte-hash plus docs/FIDELITY.md and build/fidelity.json regeneration
tasks.verify: ATTRIBUTED ALREADY, do not re-derive: all 935 of this file's original release runs are EXACTLY 4 frames long (run-length histogram {4: 935}, zero variance) and we are gated off for exactly 2 of each, giving 1870/3740 = precisely 50.0%. The cause is `HARD_RESTART_FRAMES = 2` (goatwriter.py:198) acting as a row-length-INDEPENDENT floor: `_hard_restart_ticks(1, row_calls)` returns 2 for row_calls in {3,4,5,6,8} in default, `wide` and `full` modes alike, so none of this song's three hard-restart toggles can move it. That is a mechanism, not an emitter bug. THE QUESTION THIS TASK ANSWERS: should the hard restart scale to the ORIGINAL's measured release length instead of a constant? CLAUDE.md records that the constant was already corrected once -- from 2 CALLS to 2 FRAMES -- and that `--no-test-restart` is NOT the fix for this family (it costs melody -26.3pp over 68 files). Done when either a gap-derived length is emitted and a corpus A/B shows `gate` rising with melody/seq/pitch falling on NO file, or the constant is kept with the reason written down. EITHER WAY the corpus byte-hash must move exactly the files whose measured gap differs from 2 and no others -- run the old rule beside the new one. Full suite (was 1494 passed / 2 skipped) and Commando.sng byte-exact. Regenerate docs/FIDELITY.md only after the tests pass.

tasks.title: 5 Title Tunes' adsr 58% is the original writing $0000 at every untied note end
tasks.needs_main_reason: corpus byte-hash plus docs/FIDELITY.md and build/fidelity.json regeneration
tasks.verify: FULLY ATTRIBUTED ALREADY: of 8979 compared frames the breakdown is both_zero 0, orig_zero_ours_nonzero 3743, orig_nonzero_ours_zero 0, both_nonzero_agree 5236, both_nonzero_disagree 0. So 100% of the disagreement is ONE category and wherever both sides carry a nonzero envelope they agree 5236/5236. The original rewrites $D405/$D406 to literal $0000 at every untied note's end; our `cut_release` only zeroes a release nibble that is ALREADY zero here (the mismatching value is $2400 -- AD $24, SR $00) and Goattracker's KEYOFF clears only $D404's gate bit. The ADSR-pair keys were checked first and line up exactly 7/7, so this is not a population artefact. THE HAZARD, and it is why this is opus and main: CLAUDE.md records that a register zeroed at a REST is not one zeroed at a NOTE END, and that the option fixing one destroys the other -- `cut_release` applies at every note end while some players cut only at the bit-6 rest, and `envelope_cut` (33 files) and `rest_silence_envelope` (21) are DISJOINT populations. A `CMD_SETSR $00` on the note's last row is the faithful write here, self-restoring as the player's is. It MUST be opt-in and MUST declare itself in patterns.TEMPO_OVERWRITABLE as well as ONE_SHOT_COMMANDS -- a row-0 command silently costs that subtune its CMD_SETTEMPO and has caused three separate catastrophes, ACE_II's drift 0.00 -> 1250 among them. Option in all three places (signature, presets.FIXED or FIDELITY_TOGGLES, _preset_opts). Done when 5_Title_Tunes' adsr rises toward 100% with melody/seq/pitch (all 100% today) falling on no file, the byte-hash moves only files whose player writes $0000 at note end, full suite passes and Commando.sng is byte-exact.
